prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: second high-fidelity desktop composition option for an approved visual direction, 1440×900 landscape.
Input image role: Image 1 is the visual-system reference for palette, typography character, wayfinding plates, icon style, central illustrated globe and production craft. Preserve that identity; do not copy its layout verbatim and do not carry over any logo rendering.
Primary request: Recompose the «Туту План Б» route-plan screen in the same BRIGHT WAYFINDING PAVILION world, testing a TOP CONTROL DECK composition. This is an operating interface, not a poster.
Structure: slim brand header; a compact full-width route-edit strip directly below it with «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург», dates, passengers and «Демо-данные»; a huge stylized illustrated globe centered and occupying roughly 52% of the viewport; directly above the globe, three compact wayfinding tabs «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный»; the trip summary is a narrow vertical dock on the right showing 87% and 84 600 ₽; the lower third is one continuous numbered route corridor from outbound transport to hotel to return, with one yellow «План Б» branch. Keep left side free of dashboard navigation so the planet owns the composition.
Signature interaction implied: selecting a numbered stage advances a bright line through the corridor and highlights the matching coral arc on the globe.
World: current Tutu-adjacent daylight white/cool-blue ground, deep ink navy, clear blue, vivid violet, warm coral, sunny yellow risk, mint success. Controls read like contemporary public wayfinding plates and station signage, not generic cards.
Exact text where legible: «Туту План Б», «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург», «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный», «План Б», «Демо-данные», «Устойчивость 87%», «84 600 ₽».
Constraints: preserve high contrast and dense usability; no copied brand logos, no photorealistic terrain, no stock bento grid, no left app sidebar, no dark neon mission control, no glassmorphism, no fake photography, no watermark. Show enough below the first viewport line to prove the route-builder system.
